## Review Criteria

### User Experience (UX)

**Usability:**
- [ ] Clear and intuitive navigation
- [ ] Obvious interactive elements
- [ ] Appropriate feedback for actions
- [ ] Error prevention and recovery
- [ ] Consistent mental model
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

**User Flows:**
- [ ] Logical task flows
- [ ] Minimal steps to complete tasks
- [ ] Clear entry and exit points
- [ ] Handles edge cases
- [ ] Alternative paths provided
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

**Information Architecture:**
- [ ] Logical content organization
- [ ] Clear hierarchy
- [ ] Findable information
- [ ] Appropriate labeling
- [ ] Scalable structure
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

### Visual Design (UI)

**Aesthetics:**
- [ ] Visually appealing
- [ ] Appropriate for brand
- [ ] Emotional resonance
- [ ] Professional polish
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

**Consistency:**
- [ ] Follows design system
- [ ] Consistent spacing/grid
- [ ] Consistent typography
- [ ] Consistent color usage
- [ ] Consistent component usage
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

**Visual Hierarchy:**
- [ ] Clear focal points
- [ ] Appropriate emphasis
- [ ] Scannable layout
- [ ] Readable typography
- [ ] Effective use of whitespace
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

### Accessibility

**WCAG Compliance:**
- [ ] Sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI)
- [ ] Keyboard navigable
- [ ] Screen reader compatible
- [ ] Focus indicators visible
- [ ] No reliance on color alone
- [ ] Text alternatives for images
- Compliance Level: [A/AA/AAA] | Notes: [Issues found]

**Inclusive Design:**
- [ ] Works for different abilities
- [ ] Works for different devices
- [ ] Works for different contexts
- [ ] Culturally appropriate
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

### Content

**Content Quality:**
- [ ] Clear and concise copy
- [ ] Appropriate tone
- [ ] Error-free
- [ ] Scannable
- [ ] Actionable
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

**Content Strategy:**
- [ ] Supports user goals
- [ ] Supports business goals
- [ ] SEO considerations
- [ ] Localization ready
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

### Technical Feasibility

**Implementation:**
- [ ] Technically feasible
- [ ] Uses existing components
- [ ] Reasonable complexity
- [ ] Performant approach
- [ ] No technical blockers
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Technical concerns]

**Responsive Design:**
- [ ] Mobile design provided
- [ ] Tablet design considered
- [ ] Breakpoints defined
- [ ] Touch-friendly
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

### Business Alignment

**Requirements:**
- [ ] Meets functional requirements
- [ ] Meets business goals
- [ ] Supports KPIs
- [ ] Fits timeline/budget
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]

**Strategy:**
- [ ] Aligns with product strategy
- [ ] Competitive positioning
- [ ] Scalability for future
- Rating: [1-5] | Notes: [Comments]
